title: BI/Analytics Developer
description:
Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
  

BI/Analytics Developer
  
Company: Qualitrol
  
Location: India
  
Reports To: Manager, Revenue Operations
  
About Qualitrol
  
Qualitrol is the global leader in electrical condition monitoring and protection solutions, trusted by utilities in more than 120 countries. Since 1945, we have pioneered innovations that deliver real-time insights, prevent failures, and ensure the reliability of the world's energy grid. With over 4 million installations worldwide, our monitoring technologies safeguard critical assets, extend equipment life, and reduce operational risk. Our expert service teams bring decades of hands-on experience, offering diagnostics, training, and consulting to help customers make smarter, data-driven decisions. Represented on global standards bodies, Qualitrol is recognized as a trusted advisor shaping the future of grid reliability. For over 80 years, our mission has remained clear: protecting power systems with reliable solutions that keep the lights on.
  
Job Description
  
We are seeking a BI/Analytics Developer to drive Qualitrol's Business Intelligence strategy through advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools. This role is pivotal in transforming raw Salesforce, Oracle, and forecast data into consolidated, actionable dashboards — including a unified rollup view for regional sales directors — while leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Fabric, Power BI, and Power Automate.
  
Key Responsibilities

* Build the data foundation first: semantic models, KPI definitions, data source mapping, and presentation standards, agreed with business owners and approved by the Manager, Revenue Operations.
* Lead data strategy and AI-driven analytics by applying Copilot, Fabric, Power BI, and other Power Platform tools to deliver scalable insights.
* Champion AI adoption among sales and commercial peers and leadership, leading pilot projects that demonstrate productivity gains from AI-enabled tools — this is a change-management responsibility, not just tool usage.
* Design, develop, and optimize BI solutions, including dashboards, reports, and data models that integrate Salesforce CRM data.
* Build and maintain consolidated regional-director dashboards spanning pipeline, forecast, and KPI data across all regions.
* Apply advanced analytics and AI to uncover trends, predictive insights, and opportunities for smarter decision-making.
* Establish governance standards for data quality, security, and best practices across enterprise BI platforms.
* Provide Power BI, analytics, and AI training and enablement to sales and commercial teams to drive self-service adoption.
* Support the Commercial Operations Digitization Portfolio, including the Pricing Analytics & PVM Tool and related initiatives.
* Manage BI tool subscriptions and licensing (e.g., Inforiver) as part of the reporting portfolio.

Additional Requirements

* Regular availability during agreed hours that overlap the US Eastern workday, for payout cycles, meetings, workshops and sales leadership reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience in commercial data analytics, BI, or a related role.
* Proven expertise in Microsoft Power BI, Fabric, and Power Automate.
* Experience integrating Salesforce CRM data into BI solutions.
* Experience with order forecasting and plan modeling.
* Familiarity with large language models (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.

Preferred Qualifications

* Proficiency in Python or SQL for data analysis.
* Experience with Oracle ERP.
* BS/MS degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or an equivalent field.
* Direct or indirect experience supporting sales or commercial teams.

**Ralliant Corporation Overview**

Ralliant, originally part of Fortive, now stands as a bold, independent public company driving innovation at the forefront of precision technology. With a global footprint and a legacy of excellence, we empower engineers to bring next-generation breakthroughs to life — faster, smarter, and more reliably. Our high-performance instruments, sensors, and subsystems fuel mission-critical advancements across industries, enabling real-world impact where it matters most. At Ralliant we're building the future, together with those driven to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and leave a lasting mark on the world.

**About Qualitrol**

QUALITROL manufactures monitoring and protection devices for high value electrical assets and OEM manufacturing companies. Established in 1945, QUALITROL produces thousands of different types of products on demand and customized to meet our individual customers’ needs. We are the largest and most trusted global leader for partial discharge monitoring, asset protection equipment and information products across power generation, transmission, and distribution. At Qualitrol, we are redefining condition-based monitoring.

We Are an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ralliant Corporation and all Ralliant Companies are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or other characteristics protected by law. Ralliant and all Ralliant Companies are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment application process, please contact us at applyassistance@Ralliant.com.

title: Investment Analyst (IN) Work From Office
description:
**Investment Analyst (IN)** **Work From Office**
------------------------------------------------

JOB766 3+ Years 1 Openings Ahmedabad

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Investment Analyst to support a family office's multi-asset investment portfolio. The ideal candidate will conduct investment research, evaluate opportunities across multiple asset classes, and develop actionable investment recommendations tailored to the needs of Ultra-High-Net-Worth Individuals (UHNIs) and family offices.

This role requires strong financial and analytical capabilities, sound investment judgment, and the ability to leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency and decision-making.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Investment Research**

* Research and evaluate investment opportunities across listed equities, fixed income and debt instruments, REITs, InvITs, and structured products.

**2. Investment Recommendations**

* Translate research findings and investment ideas into clear, concise investment memos with actionable recommendations.

**3. Portfolio Monitoring**

* Track existing portfolio holdings, assess investment performance, monitor risks, and identify key market developments and investment catalysts.

**4. Multi-Asset Analysis**

* Evaluate investment opportunities based on risk-return profiles, market conditions, valuation, and portfolio objectives.

**5. AI-Enabled Research**

* Effectively use AI tools to accelerate research, investment screening, data analysis, and drafting while applying independent judgment to validate findings and conclusions.

**6. Market Intelligence**

* Monitor relevant market trends, economic developments, and regulatory changes that may affect investment decisions.

**7. Investment Support**

* Assist in evaluating new opportunities and providing research-backed insights to support portfolio allocation and investment decisions.

### **Required Qualifications and Skills**

* **Mandatory Qualification:** CA (Chartered Accountant) or equivalent qualification, along with CFA Level III candidacy or higher.
* **Relevant Experience:** 1–4 years of experience in buy-side research, family offices, wealth management, investment research, or related financial services roles is preferred.
* Strong analytical, financial modelling, research, and critical-thinking skills.
* Good understanding of investment products commonly used by UHNIs and family offices.
* Ability to evaluate investment opportunities across multiple asset classes and articulate the associated risks and potential returns.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to enhance research workflows, screening, analysis, and documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex investment ideas clearly and concisely.
* High ownership mindset, attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a strong sense of accountability.

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders

* Prepare and review BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process flow diagrams
* Facilitate requirement workshops and stakeholder meetings
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure aligned delivery
* Conduct gap analysis, feasibility studies, and impact assessments
* Track project KPIs and drive continuous process improvement
* Manage stakeholder communication, status updates, and risk escalation
* Review deliverables prepared by team members for quality and accuracy

* 7+ years of experience in Business Analysis, including 2+ years leading or mentoring a team

title: Business Analyst
description:

**Company:** Vindaloo Softtech Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Experience:** 2.5 - 4 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Vindaloo Softtech**

Vindaloo Softtech Pvt. Ltd. is a technology and software development company specializing in **VoIP software solutions, custom software development, web and mobile applications, CRM solutions, and other technology services**. We work with businesses to develop customized and scalable technology solutions.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a **Business Analyst** with **2 - 4 years of experience** in the IT/software industry. The ideal candidate will be responsible for understanding business and client requirements, translating them into clear functional requirements, and coordinating with development, QA, and other internal teams to ensure successful project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements.
* Communicate with clients and stakeholders to understand their business needs and objectives.
* Prepare and maintain **BRD, FRD, user stories, use cases, workflows, and process flow diagrams**.
* Act as a communication bridge between clients, stakeholders, developers, QA, and project teams.
* Participate in requirement-gathering meetings, client calls, project discussions, and demos.
* Analyze existing business processes and identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into clear and actionable functional requirements for technical teams.
* Coordinate with developers and QA teams to ensure requirements are properly understood and implemented.
* Support **UAT** and requirement validation.
* Track requirement changes and ensure proper documentation and communication.
* Identify project dependencies, risks, and requirement gaps.
* Work closely with Project Managers and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure deliverables are aligned with client requirements and expectations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **2 - 4 years of experience as a Business Analyst in the IT/software industry.**
* Strong knowledge of requirement gathering and requirement analysis.
* Good understanding of **SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies**.
* Hands-on experience preparing BRD, FRD, user stories, use cases, and process flows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and coordinate with different teams.
* Experience with **Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar tools** will be an advantage.

**Good to Have**

* Experience working on web, mobile, SaaS, CRM, or communication/VoIP-related software projects.
* Basic understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and software architecture.
* Experience in client-facing roles.
* Understanding of wireframes/prototypes and tools such as Figma will be an advantage.

**Why Join Vindaloo Softtech?**

* Opportunity to work on diverse software and technology projects.
* Exposure to international clients and technology-driven solutions.
* Collaborative and learning-focused work environment.
* Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
* Exposure to the complete software development lifecycle.
